scope: Native Android headless-system-user boot strategy; device runtime configuration, not a firmware image overlay
conditions: Pinned physical USB identity, ADB serial, Android boot and observed system/vendor fingerprints
Android boot complete and SELinux Enforcing
Headless mode true and config_hsumBootStrategy resource equals 1
No explicit owner override: existing property is empty or -1
Framework strategy agrees with the property/resource
Mutation requires normally unlocked foreground owner and an empty VM registry
effects: Request Android's native previous-or-first-switchable-user algorithm at boot
Keep normal keyguard, credential policy, headless-system-user mode and firmware unchanged
reversal: With the qualified target and quiescent normally unlocked owner, restore-donor sets -1, the native resource-default sentinel. It does not delete the persistent property or select a specific user.
limitations: The example validates caller-pinned fingerprints; this JSON is a versioned recipe, not an automatically executed build stage
A mutation receipt alone does not prove reboot behavior; runtime reboot evidence is separate
One native owner-selection reboot is qualified; new owners, factory reset and updated donor builds require requalification
